title: Tool-Selection Hijacking: Auditing Open Agent Frameworks for ToolHijacker

original_idea.body: Flowchart-image jailbreaks on open VLMs (extends FC-Attack arXiv:2502.21059): render harmful procedures as flowcharts, prompt Qwen2-VL/LLaVA to complete steps, measure visual-channel uplift vs plain text.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Quantifying visual-channel bypass on widely-deployed weaker open VLMs is a concrete, actionable safety chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Flowchart-render pipeline + 2-3 open VLMs + StrongReject; VLM tooling adds modest complexity.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused visual-vs-text success comparison; building the render pipeline adds effort.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open VLMs, inference-only, weaker safety than frontier; high independent value.

novelty.reasoning: FC-Attack on small open VLMs uncharacterized; likely mostly novel.
